facilityHierarchy.name: Basic Health Unit (BHU)
facilityHierarchy.description: Primary healthcare for catchment of 10,000-25,000 population
facilityHierarchy.services: Preventive care, basic curative, MCH, EPI, family planning

facilityHierarchy.name: Rural Health Centre (RHC)
facilityHierarchy.description: Enhanced primary care with 10-20 beds for 25,000-100,000 population
facilityHierarchy.services: BHU services plus minor surgeries, lab, dental, X-ray

facilityHierarchy.name: Tehsil Headquarters Hospital (THQ)
facilityHierarchy.description: First referral hospital at tehsil/sub-district level with 40-60 beds

facilityHierarchy.name: District Headquarters Hospital (DHQ)
facilityHierarchy.description: Secondary care hospital at district level with 100-250 beds
facilityHierarchy.services: All THQ services plus specialty clinics, diagnostic services

facilityHierarchy.name: Teaching/Tertiary Hospital
facilityHierarchy.description: Tertiary care and medical education with 500-2000+ beds

priorityPrograms.name: Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI)
priorityPrograms.challenges: Refusal, hard-to-reach populations, cold chain gaps

priorityPrograms.name: TB DOTS Programme
priorityPrograms.challenges: Case detection gap (37%), MDR-TB, treatment adherence

priorityPrograms.name: Hepatitis Control Programme
priorityPrograms.challenges: High prevalence (HCV 5-8%), screening coverage, treatment access

priorityPrograms.name: Sehat Sahulat Programme
priorityPrograms.challenges: Provider fraud, claims processing, benefit awareness

challenges.description: Limited health IT infrastructure, especially in rural facilities; frequent power outages; low internet connectivity in remote areas
Severe shortage of health informatics professionals; 1 doctor per 1,000 population; health worker distribution skewed toward urban areas
Inconsistent data collection; paper-based records in majority of BHUs; duplicate patient records across facilities
Post-18th Amendment devolution; fragmented health governance across provinces; no unified health information architecture
Siloed health systems; no national health information exchange; multiple incompatible HMIS implementations
Health expenditure only 3.2% of GDP; high out-of-pocket spending (56%); limited analytics budget allocation
No comprehensive health data privacy legislation; limited cybersecurity capacity in health facilities
Gender barriers to healthcare access; low health literacy; resistance to data sharing across institutional boundaries
